name: HalluDial
description: HalluDial is a large-scale benchmark for automatic dialogue-level hallucination evaluation, covering both spontaneous and induced hallucinations across factuality and faithfulness. It includes over 4,000 dialogues and 146,856 samples, enabling comprehensive meta-evaluation of LLM hallucination detection and localization in information-seeking dialogues.
reputation: A recent research benchmark from the hallucination-evaluation literature that is gaining attention for dialogue-level hallucination analysis, but it is not yet a widely established standard.
notes: First benchmark focusing on dialogue-level hallucination evaluation including faithfulness; introduces HalluJudge model for evaluation.
